title: Manipal Health Enterprises IPO Details
intro:
Manipal Health Enterprises IPO is a book build issue of ₹9,275.22 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 13.56 crore shares aggregating to ₹8,000.00 crores and offer for sale of 2.16 crore shares aggregating to ₹1,275.22 crores.

Manipal Health Enterprises IPO opens for subscription on Jul 29, 2026 and closes on Jul 31, 2026. The allotment for the Manipal Health Enterprises IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 3, 2026. Manipal Health Enterprises IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 5, 2026.

Manipal Health Enterprises IPO is set issue price band at ₹560 to ₹590 per share. The lot size for an application is 25 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,750 (25 shares) (based on upper price).

The issue includes a reservation of up to 2,80,899 shares for employees offered at a discount of ₹56.00 to the issue price.

Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2010, Manipal Health Enterprises Limited is a healthcare service providers, operating a large network of multi-specialty hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centres across the country. It is part of the Manipal Group, founded by T. M. A. Pai.vThe company offers a wide range of healthcare services including tertiary and quaternary care, organ transplants, oncology, cardiology, neurology, orthopaedics, and preventive healthcare. Its hospitals are equipped with advanced medical technology and are staffed by experienced medical professionals.

Manipal Health focuses on delivering quality, patient-centric care and expanding access to healthcare through strategic acquisitions, partnerships, and continuous investment in medical infrastructure and digital health initiatives. As of March 31, 2026, the company operated 49 hospitals with 13,037 licensed beds. They are operating 21 clinics as of March 31, 2026.

As of March 31, 2026, the company had 24,240 full-time employees across its hospitals and corporate functions. The workforce comprised 11,048 nurses, 6,362 paramedics, and 6,830 administrative employees, supporting its healthcare operations and patient services.
strengths: India’s largest multispecialty hospital group by bed capacity with pan-India presence and leadership in our three key region.
We are the only private hospital chain network in India with leadership in three metros (Bengaluru, Kolkata and Pune) with a balanced and diversified presence across metros and non-metros.
Widely recognized brand and network of choice for patients, doctors and healthcare professionals
Advanced infrastructure and medical equipment, with a strong focus on clinical excellence
Track record of delivering industry leading growth with strong profitability and efficiency metric

faqs.question: How to apply in Manipal Health Enterprises IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Manipal Health Enterprises IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Manipal Health Enterprises IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Manipal Health Enterprises IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Manipal Health Enterprises IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The Manipal Health Enterprises IPO opens on Wed, Jul 29, 2026 and closes on Fri, Jul 31, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Manipal Health Enterprises IPO?
faqs.answer: Manipal Health Enterprises IPO lot size is 25 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,750 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Manipal Health Enterprises IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Manipal Health Enterprises IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Manipal Health Enterprises IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Manipal Health Enterprises IPO will be done on Monday, August 3, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Aug 4, 2026 . Check the Manipal Health Enterprises IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Manipal Health Enterprises IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Manipal Health Enterprises IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Aug 5, 2026 .
